Short answer: Choose Calendly for meetings and routing around work calendars. Choose Square Appointments when the booking is a paid service with staff, resources, deposits, and checkout.

What this means for your business

Both can put time on a calendar. The difference appears after the click: what gets reserved, whether money moves, what staff need, and how the client returns.

What to watch

  • A meeting tool stretched into chairs, rooms, classes, or service inventory.
  • A service platform bought for simple introductory calls.
  • Two tools both writing availability.
  • Reminders, payment, cancellation, and follow-up handled in separate manual steps.

Do this next

  1. Write the most complicated real appointment.
  2. Name calendars, staff, resources, deposit, checkout, and reminders.
  3. Build and cancel that appointment in each trial.
  4. Compare the plan and payment terms needed for the complete flow.

When Little Fight fits

We connect the chosen booking door to the website and follow-up. We do not replace a working calendar because a comparison page needs a winner.

Get a plain-English second opinion
